extracted.intended_audience: broadcast and digital journalists, news organizations, and RTDNA members (especially those submitting work for awards)
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria for judging or producing award-worthy broadcast and digital news stories per the Radio Television Digital News Association (RTDNA), with emphasis on ethics, technical proficiency, and public-service impact. Applies to entries for the Edward R. Murrow Awards and to professional conduct promoted by RTDNA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold the RTDNA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Work must 'uphold the RTDNA Code of Ethics' as a core criterion for recognition (explicitly cited as a requirement for Edward R. Murrow Awards).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RTDNA Code of Ethics is linked from the page; adherence to its principles (accuracy, fairness, independence, transparency, etc.) is expected. This functions as a gating/qualifying standard for award consideration and professional conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate technical expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Demonstrate technical expertise' is listed as an explicit criterion for Edward R. Murrow Award-winning work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical expertise refers to the craft and technical execution of broadcast/digital journalism (production, editing, use of technology). The page does not further define scoring rubrics; judges apply this as a quality dimension when comparing entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemplify importance and impact as journalism serving the community
rubrics_metrics.description: Award-winning work should 'exemplify the importance and impact of journalism as a service to the community.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion emphasizes public-service value: stories that meaningfully inform, affect public understanding, or serve community needs. Impact and societal importance are considered alongside craft and ethics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conform to the standard of excellence associated with Edward R. Murrow
rubrics_metrics.description: Murrow Award entries should 'demonstrate the excellence that Edward R. Murrow made a standard for the broadcast news profession.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a broad, high-level quality standard invoking journalistic excellence, integrity, and professional leadership. It is normative and used as an overarching evaluative benchmark rather than a narrowly defined metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: recognizes local and national news stories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edward R. Murrow Awards 'recognize local and national news stories' — indicating eligible work spans local and national reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notes the applicable scope/categories of work considered for the awards (local and national journalism). The page does not enumerate specific category rules or entry requirements beyond scope and the other criteria above.
